about: Hand-made answer-correctness rubric for the 18 golden questions that have an expected source. Facts come from docs/corpus (each marker is a verbatim phrase that must occur in its source file; tests/test_answer_rubric.py checks that). Verdicts are one rater's reading, the AI rater's, of the saved answers: not independent, so spot-check them. Each verdict is tied to the SHA-256 of the answer it judged; scripts/score_answers.py refuses stale ones.

verdicts.correct: States the facts the question needs, and nothing the corpus contradicts or lacks.
verdicts.partly_correct: Says only true things but leaves out a fact the question asks for.
verdicts.declined_appropriate: Declines, and the corpus really does not answer the question.
verdicts.declined_answerable: Declines, although the corpus answers the question.
verdicts.wrong: Says something the corpus contradicts or does not contain.
verdicts.no_answer: No answer was produced (the routing step failed or refused).

questions.fact: Perishable products (refrigerated, frozen, fresh produce, bakery, anything expiring within 14 days of delivery) cannot be physically returned; a quality problem gets a refund or replacement if reported within 48 hours with a photo (sections 3.1, 3.2).

openai.reason: States that perishables cannot be returned, and the 48-hour photo rule for bad condition.

ollama.reason: Refuses and says the policy does not mention perishables, although the rule was the second excerpt.

questions.fact: Zone 1 (Montréal métropolitain): standard delivery is next-day; express is same-day for orders placed and paid before 11 h Eastern (sections 1, 2.2).

openai.reason: Gives the dispatch cut-off (14 h) and same-day express, both true, but not that standard delivery is next-day.

ollama.reason: Gives the 14 h dispatch cut-off, and says it lacks the delivery time, which is next-day.

questions.marker: Frozen shipments are only available for Zones 1 and 2
questions.fact: Frozen items ship in insulated containers with dry ice, to Zones 1 and 2 only; in Zones 3 and 4 they are removed and refunded, with an email before dispatch (section 4.2).

openai.reason: Zones 1 and 2 only, insulated containers with dry ice: as written. Leaves out the Zone 3/4 refund rule.

ollama.reason: Zones 1 and 2 only, insulated containers with dry ice: as written.

questions.fact: The corpus has no allergen list for bakery products. It says product pages carry a 'Contains' box and the physical label lists priority allergens (3.1); only the prepared meals have a stated advisory (4.2).

openai.reason: Says the policies do not list bakery allergens.

ollama.reason: Says the policies do not answer it.

questions.fact: Members earn 1 point per $1 spent, before taxes and after discounts; shipping fees earn nothing; some categories earn bonus points (sections 2.1, 2.2).

openai.reason: 1 point per $1 before taxes and after discounts, the bonus rates, the welcome bonus: all as written.

ollama.reason: 1 point per $1 before taxes and after discounts, and names the bonus categories.

questions.marker: eligible for a full refund or replacement
questions.fact: Damaged or defective items are eligible for a full refund or replacement, reported within 48 hours with a photo (section 4).

openai.reason: Damaged items get a full refund or replacement if reported within 48 hours with a photo.

ollama.reason: Refuses; the damaged-items section was the second excerpt.

questions.fact: It collects identity, contact, payment (tokenised), transaction, delivery, behavioural, device, loyalty, communications and AI-derived data (section 2).

openai.reason: Lists all ten categories of personal data and their purposes, as in the table.

ollama.reason: Names 3 of the 10 categories, with French labels in an English answer; cites the French notice.

questions.fact: The corpus has no procedure for cancelling an ordinary order. It covers only Boréal Box subscriptions: individual deliveries up to 72 hours before dispatch, or My Account > Subscriptions > Cancel (section 7).

openai.reason: Says the policies do not cover cancelling an existing order.

ollama.reason: Says the policies do not cover cancelling an existing order.

questions.fact: Three tiers over a rolling 12 months: Pousse $0-499, Sapin $500-1,499, Étoile $1,500+ (section 3).

openai.reason: Three tiers with their spend ranges and perks, as in the table.

ollama.reason: Three tiers with their spend ranges, as in the table.

questions.fact: Free shipping starts at $75 (Zone 1), $100 (Zone 2), $150 (Zone 3) or $200 (Zone 4), on the subtotal before taxes (section 3).

openai.reason: Free-shipping thresholds of $75, $100, $150 and $200 by zone, as in the table.

ollama.reason: Thresholds are right, but it opens by saying there is no free-shipping option, which the policy contradicts.

questions.fact: You can request deletion of your account and associated data, subject to legal retention, through privacy@borealmarche.ca, answered within 30 days (sections 8, 12). Closing only the loyalty account is separate: fidelite@borealmarche.ca (loyalty section 9).

openai.reason: Refuses and cites the loyalty terms; the privacy notice's deletion right was not among the excerpts.

ollama.reason: Refuses and cites the loyalty terms; the privacy notice's deletion right was not among the excerpts.

questions.marker: the points earned on that order are deducted
questions.fact: A returned order loses the points it earned; points redeemed on it are restored and the refund is reduced by the discount (section 7).

openai.reason: Points earned are deducted; points redeemed are restored and the refund reduced: as in section 7.

ollama.reason: Refuses; section 7 of the loyalty terms was the second excerpt.

questions.fact: The corpus says ambient items ship in 'standard cardboard boxes' (4.3). It says nothing about recyclability.

openai.reason: Says the policies do not cover it.

ollama.reason: Says the policies do not cover it.

questions.marker: Free pickup is available at our Montréal warehouse
questions.fact: Free click-and-collect at the Montréal warehouse (4300 rue Saint-Ambroise) and the Québec City depot (1150 boulevard Charest Ouest); ready within 4 hours, held 48 hours (section 2.3).

openai.reason: Free click-and-collect at the Montréal warehouse and the Québec City depot, ready in 4 hours, held 48 hours.

ollama.reason: States the free pickup at the warehouse and depot, then says it cannot answer and that the policy does not mention picking up in store.

questions.fact: Frozen products cannot be physically returned (section 3.1).

openai.reason: Frozen products cannot be returned; a refund or replacement within 48 hours if the condition is bad.

ollama.reason: Right on both rules, but garbled words ('dégagé', 'remise' for replacement).

questions.fact: Zone 1 (Montréal métropolitain): standard delivery is next-day (section 1).

openai.reason: Next-day standard delivery with the 14 h cut-off, and same-day express before 11 h.

ollama.reason: Answers about dispatch, not delivery, and says orders before 14 h ship 'the same day or the next', which the policy does not.

questions.fact: You can request deletion of your account and associated data through the privacy officer, answered within 30 days (sections 8, 12 of the French notice).

openai.reason: Right about closing the loyalty account; says it cannot answer about personal data.

ollama.reason: Attributes data deletion to the loyalty terms and says it cannot be done on the site or app; no policy says either.

questions.fact: The corpus has no allergen list for bakery products (see question 4).

openai.reason: Says bakery products 'may therefore contain' the priority allergens; no policy lists bakery allergens.

ollama.reason: Lists allergens bakery products 'must declare', including items the policy does not name (maize yeast, coconut).
